wiki.title: Jason Bunting
wiki.extract: Jason Bunting is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives. Bunting was appointed by the Republican Representative Committee of the 106th Representative District to represent the 106th district on February 4, 2023. The 106th district, located in Central Illinois, includes all or parts of Ford, Grundy, Iroquois, LaSalle, Livingston, McLean, and Will counties.
